continuity: The Invincible Divine Sword is Cheongpung, who has been hiding under the false name Kang Pung after escaping the journey back to Huashan.
Cheongpung and Jin Taekyung intend to settle their renewed rivalry in the Star-Array Grand Banquet finals.
The Hidden Shadow Pavilion's finest agent, Shadow Killer, served Song Ho for decades and was incapacitated by Jongni Chu after attacking him.
plot: Jin Taekyung learns that Zhuge Gyun was completely outclassed and defeated by the Invincible Divine Sword. He recognizes the disguised opponent as Cheongpung after baiting him with the false identity of Park Taekyung of the Taiyuan Park Family; Cheongpung has been using the false name Kang Pung.

Cheongpung explains that he fled from the Three Plum Blossom Elites while returning to Huashan and spent the year traveling, eating dumplings, and barely training. He intends to remain disguised at the Star-Array Grand Banquet and face Taekyung in the finals, confidently claiming he will win.

Jongni Chu meets Taekyung and Cheongpung, immediately befriends the disguised Cheongpung, then walks past the inn and calls out about the Invincible Divine Sword. A masked Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent attacks him, but Jongni Chu overwhelms and incapacitates the agent before he can bite his poison pellet.
translation_decisions: Use Kang Pung for 강풍 as Cheongpung's false name, Shadow Killer for 암중살, and Taiyuan Park Family for 태원박가.
Keep Cheongpung's exposed voice bright, clear, innocent, and casually enthusiastic; his deep voice is an artificial disguise.

active_continuity: The Demonic Cult's four-month conquest of Qinghai, Gansu, and Sichuan caused the orthodox factions, unorthodox forces, and dark-path powers to unite under the Martial God's banner and create the Murim Alliance.
The Murim Alliance dissolved after the ten-year Great War and the Martial God's disappearance, but its former site remains active and hosts the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
Jin Taekyung defeated Black Water Dart with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist and has four main-event victories, each lasting less than fifteen minutes.
The Star-Array Grand Banquet began with five hundred finalists; roughly thirty were expected to remain after the third day's duels.
Baek Woo uses the Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms and was instructed by his Master to get along with Taekyung.
Gung Gibang has mastered the Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms to the fifth level.

Song Ho was formerly the head of the Murim Alliance's Hidden Shadow Pavilion, an intelligence network once comparable to or superior to the Beggars' Sect's, and he has attended every day of the main event.
Jongni Chu has four victories, is known as the Life-Sustaining Sword because he repeatedly wins by a narrow margin, and has now befriended the disguised Cheongpung.
Zhuge Gyun was completely outclassed and defeated by the Invincible Divine Sword.
Cheongpung is the Invincible Divine Sword, has used the false name Kang Pung, escaped the journey back to Huashan, and plans to face Taekyung in the finals.
Cheongpung spent the intervening year traveling through the martial world and eating dumplings rather than seriously training.
Shadow Killer was the Hidden Shadow Pavilion's finest agent, had completed hundreds of missions, and had loyally served Song Ho for decades.
Jongni Chu overwhelmed and incapacitated Shadow Killer after the agent attacked him in a secluded alley.

profile_creations.personality: Disciplined and loyal; when captured, he attempted to bite a poison pellet rather than reveal information.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Mysterious young man encountered at Honghwa Inn; an exceptionally young Peak master whose Level Jin Taekyung cannot determine through Qi Sense; the grandson and disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, who secretly descended from Huashan to seek out and defeat the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes, beginning with Jin Mukyung; he has no martial title yet, naturally opened his Governor Vessel through enlightenment two years ago, has begun teaching Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin using Mae Jonghak's training method, has now used Sword Energy and the Zaha Divine Technique during his spar with Taekyung, defended Taekyung from Jeok Cheongang with Huashan martial arts, and Prince Shangshan will only accept his autograph after he gains one; he claims Mae Jonghak has permitted him to become Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and follow Taekyung to Anhui; after departing with the Three Plum Blossom Elites for Huashan, he fled during the journey and is currently missing.
